ops.text: Vendor owns its generic tools and know-how. The revocable, non-transferable, and Order Form term limitations on Customer's Deliverable licence in Section 14.2 do not apply, and Customer instead receives a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, modify, and sublicense each Deliverable for its business.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] Rather than rewrite Section 14.2, we have added one short clause at our fallback: Vendor keeps its generic tools and know-how, but our Deliverable licence becomes perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide and royalty-free, and we may use, modify and sublicense Deliverables for our business. This disapplies only the revocable, non-transferable and Order Form term limitations in Section 14.2, which leave us with no usable rights in work product we paid for.
proposal.summary: Add a fallback clause: Vendor owns generic tools and know-how; Customer gets a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, modify and sublicense Deliverables.
